headline.en: Apollo backs Hong Kong's The Executive Centre with $585m financing
headline.zh: Apollo以5.85亿美元融资支持香港的The Executive Centre

summary.en: Apollo has provided $585m in financing to Hong Kong-based The Executive Centre. The article gives no further details on the structure or terms of the deal.
summary.zh: Apollo已向总部位于香港的The Executive Centre提供5.85亿美元融资。文章未提供有关该交易结构或条款的更多细节。

headline.en: Apollo backs Asia flex-office giant with $590 million debt deal
headline.zh: Apollo以5.9亿美元债务交易支持亚洲灵活办公巨头

summary.en: Apollo has provided a $590 million debt deal to an unnamed Asia flex-office giant, according to Dealroom.
summary.zh: 据Dealroom报道，Apollo向一家未具名的亚洲灵活办公巨头提供了5.9亿美元的债务交易。

headline.en: Apollo Provides $585 Million Financing to The Executive Centre
headline.zh: Apollo 向 The Executive Centre 提供 5.85 亿美元融资

summary.en: Apollo provided $585 million in financing to The Executive Centre, according to Apollo Global Management. No further terms or details were disclosed.
summary.zh: 据 Apollo Global Management 消息，Apollo 向 The Executive Centre 提供了 5.85 亿美元融资。未披露更多条款或细节。

headline.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance Expands Loan Financing Facility
headline.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance 扩大贷款融资安排

summary.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance expanded a loan financing facility, according to TipRanks. No further details were provided in the article.
summary.zh: 据 TipRanks 报道，Blue Owl Technology Finance 扩大了一项贷款融资安排。文章未提供更多细节。

headline.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance Boosts Credit Line to $250 Million via Subsidiary Amendment
headline.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance通过子公司修订将信贷额度提高至2.5亿美元

summary.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance increased its credit line to $250 million through an amendment at a subsidiary.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance通过子公司的修订，将其信贷额度提高至2.5亿美元。

headline.en: Fortress Co-CEO Warns Private Credit On AI Deals: 'You're Not Getting Paid For That Upside'
headline.zh: Fortress联席首席执行官就AI交易警告私人信贷：“你没有获得上行回报”

summary.en: Fortress Co-CEO warned private credit lenders against AI-related deals, saying lenders are not being paid for the upside. The warning concerned underwriting in AI deals.
summary.zh: Fortress联席首席执行官就AI相关交易向私人信贷贷款机构发出警告，称贷款方未获得上行回报。该警告针对AI交易的承销。

headline.en: Private credit defaults rise, led by small companies, healthcare – Houlihan Lokey
headline.zh: Houlihan Lokey：私募信贷违约率上升，小公司和医疗保健行业居首

summary.en: Private credit defaults have risen, with small companies and healthcare leading the increase, according to Houlihan Lokey.
summary.zh: Houlihan Lokey 表示，私募信贷违约率上升，其中小公司和医疗保健行业的违约增长最为显著。

headline.en: Blue Owl Capital Corporation ratings affirmed at BBB+ with stable outlook
headline.zh: Blue Owl Capital Corporation 评级确认为 BBB+，展望稳定

summary.en: Blue Owl Capital Corporation had its ratings affirmed at BBB+ with a stable outlook.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Capital Corporation 的评级被确认为 BBB+，展望稳定。

headline.en: Private credit default rate rises to 6.3% in 12 months through August
headline.zh: 私人信贷违约率在截至8月的12个月内升至6.3%

summary.en: The private credit default rate rose to 6.3% in the 12 months through August, according to CNBC.
summary.zh: 据CNBC报道，私人信贷违约率在截至8月的12个月内升至6.3%。
